This '''female [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilot''' flew for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWGS5" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I really enjoyed rendering a female pilot from the climax of the original film. We never see a female pilot preparing for battle, and I think it'd be a neat wrinkle to catch a moment like this.|Darwyn Cooke|<ref name="SWGS5" />}}
Illustrator [[Wikipedia:Darwyn Cooke|Darwyn Cooke]] created the pilot for a ''[[2010 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 5]]'' card, suggesting she was an unseen participant in the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="SWGS5" />
